Job description:

 
The Associate Nurse Unit Manager (ANUM) on Ward 5B works closely with the Nurse Unit Manager (NUM) and senior staff to support the delivery of high-quality, evidence-based patient care within a collaborative multidisciplinary team. The role includes assisting with staff and resource management, providing operational leadership, coordinating daily patient care activities, and supporting patient flow.

Ward 5B is a 32-bed surgical ward caring for patients undergoing Orthopaedic, Plastic and Reconstructive, Gynaecological, General, Breast, and Ear, Nose and Throat (ENT) surgery. The ward is committed to a patient- and family-centred approach, using effective communication and teamwork to ensure safe, coordinated care and discharge planning. A strong emphasis is placed on collaboration, supporting learners, and fostering teamwork within a busy surgical environment.

 

 






 

The Role

The Associate Nurse Unit Manager (ANUM) is an experienced nurse who, within the defined are of practice:

Works in partnership with the Nurse Unit Manager (NUM) and other senior staff, to ensure the efficient and effective provision of care based on best practice principles within a collaborative and multidisciplinary framework.

Assists the NUM with the planning and management of staff and resources and provides operational leadership through the coordination of the day-to-day patient care activities, including patient flow.

Note: - Please refer to the Statement of Duties for all the selection criteria of this position to address in your application.

The Ward

Ward 5B is a 32-bed surgical ward. We care for a range of surgical patients undergoing Orthopaedic, Plastic & Reconstructive, Gynaecological, General, Breast, and Ear, Nose & Throat Surgery.

The staff on 5B believe in a multidisciplinary team approach to health care that places the needs of our patients and their families-carers first through communication and collaboration to facilitate a safe discharge from hospital. 

We provide a supportive environment for learners and place a heavy focus on teamwork to assist in facilitating the needs of our busy surgical ward.

Why Tasmania

The Department of Health Tasmania oversees various hospitals across the state, including the Royal Hobart Hospital, Launceston General Hospital, Northwest Regional Hospital, and Mersey Community Hospital, as well as district hospitals and ambulance services. Additionally, it provides community health, mental health, and primary healthcare services to the Tasmanian community through more than 300 sites.

Tasmania, Australia's only island state, offers unparalleled natural beauty and a luxurious lifestyle. Pursuing your health career in Tasmania's public health system means building strong connections with colleagues and patients. It also means embracing a lifestyle where you can enjoy extraordinary experiences outside of work while making a significant impact on the community during work.

result.description: FRIENDLY GROCER SANDSTONE LAKES  Golden Eagle Logistics & Transport Pty. Ltd. trading as Friendly Grocer Sandstone Lakes is seeking a skilled and experienced  Retail Manager  to manage the day-to-day operations of its community-focused grocery and convenience store.  The Retail Manager will oversee store performance, inventory, purchasing, staff management, merchandising, customer service and operational compliance. The position requires strong retail management capability and the ability to manage a diverse product range, including groceries, fresh and packaged food, deli products, takeaway items and other convenience retail products.   Benefits   Competitive salary plus superannuation.  Supportive and community-focused working environment.  Ongoing training and professional development.  Career progression opportunities.  Employee discounts, where applicable.    Task & responsibilities   Manage the overall day-to-day operations of the grocery and convenience store, including sales, staffing, customer service and store presentation.  Determine the appropriate product range, stock levels and service standards according to customer demand and business requirements.  Manage purchasing, ordering and inventory control for groceries, fresh food, deli products, beverages, takeaway items and other retail products.  Monitor perishable stock, product quality, expiry dates, stock rotation and wastage to maintain appropriate food quality and profitability.  Liaise and negotiate with suppliers regarding product availability, purchasing costs, delivery schedules, promotional offers and stock replenishment.  Develop and implement pricing, merchandising, promotional and local marketing strategies to increase sales and customer engagement.  Monitor sales performance, store budgets, operating costs and financial transactions to improve profitability and operational efficiency.  Recruit, train, roster, supervise and evaluate retail employees to ensure effective store coverage and service delivery.  Establish and maintain store procedures relating to cash handling, point-of-sale operations, inventory management and daily administration.  Maintain attractive and commercially effective product displays, promotional areas and store presentation standards.  Manage customer enquiries and complaints and maintain a high standard of customer service.  Ensure compliance with food safety, workplace health and safety, employment and other applicable retail regulatory requirements.  Oversee the operation of additional store services, including coffee, deli, takeaway food, Lotto and Scratchies, in accordance with applicable procedures and regulatory requirements.    Qualification & experience   AQF Diploma or higher qualification in Retail Management, Business, Management or a related field;  At least 2-4 years of relevant full-time work experience.  Demonstrated experience managing a grocery, supermarket, convenience store or similar fast-paced retail establishment.  Experience managing inventory, fresh or perishable products, purchasing, budgets and sales performance.  Strong leadership, staff supervision, rostering and team development skills.  Excellent communication, organisational and customer service abilities.  Sound commercial awareness and the ability to analyse sales and operational performance.  Experience using point-of-sale systems and inventory management software.  Understanding of food safety, workplace health and safety and general retail compliance requirements.  Experience managing Lotto or similar supplementary retail services will be highly regarded.   About Company     Golden Eagle Logistics & Transport Pty. Ltd. trading as Friendly Grocer Sandstone Lakes  operates an independently managed neighbourhood grocery and convenience store located at Shop 4, 1–7 Sandstone Boulevard, Ningi, Queensland 4511.  The store provides the local community with convenient access to everyday groceries and essential household products, together with fresh meat, deli products, coffee, takeaway food etc. The business is committed to maintaining reliable local service, competitive product offerings, a welcoming shopping environment and strong relationships with customers and suppliers. The Friendly Grocer group supports independently owned stores through collective buying and marketing arrangements while stores remain locally owned and managed.  Our client is a well-established construction contractor with a strong pipeline of work across South East Queensland. Due to continued project growth, they are seeking an experienced General Foreman / Supervisor to join the team on a landmark high-rise residential development in the Coolangatta area. 
 This is an opportunity to join a reputable builder with a collaborative culture, strong safety focus and a proven track record of delivering quality projects.

 Reporting to the Site Manager, you will be responsible for coordinating daily site activities and ensuring construction works are delivered safely, efficiently and to programme.  Key Responsibilities 
 
 Coordinate and supervise day-to-day site operations 
 Manage subcontractors, suppliers and labour resources 
 Ensure works are completed in accordance with programme requirements 
 Monitor and enforce site safety systems and procedures 
 Conduct daily pre-starts, toolbox talks and site inspections 
 Oversee construction quality and defect prevention 
 Coordinate construction sequencing and trade interfaces 
 Identify and resolve site issues to minimise delays 
 Assist with planning and programming activities 
 Ensure compliance with statutory, environmental and company requirements 
 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Previous experience as a General Foreman, Supervisor or Senior Foreman on commercial or multi-residential projects 
 Demonstrated experience delivering medium to high-rise construction projects 
 Strong subcontractor management and coordination skills 
 Thorough understanding of construction methodologies and sequencing 
 Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications 
 Excellent communication and leadership skills 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Opportunity to work on a flagship high-rise development 
 Join a respected builder with a strong project pipeline 
 Competitive salary package 
 Supportive and collaborative team environment 
 Long-term career progression opportunities
